payload.text: SAFETY/ORACLE — equity_bsm_price is the independent golden reference for generalized Black-Scholes-Merton equity vanillas (carry b = r - q - repo), NOT the engine's own pricer: for t<=0 it returns intrinsic max(sign·(S-K),0); otherwise d1=(ln(S/K)+(b+½σ²)t)/(σ√t), d2=d1-σ√t, with cost-of-carry-discounted spot s_disc=S·exp((b-r)t) and rate-discounted strike k_disc=K·exp(-r·t), Call=s_disc·N(d1)-k_disc·N(d2) and the Put complement. It is pure and deterministic over its 8 scalar inputs (libm only, no I/O/mutation/allocation), serving as a can-disagree oracle gating equity-vanilla parity (dividend yield + repo carry) against the engine. Self-invalidates if the carry decomposition drifts.
